challenges.title: A shopping cart with discounts
challenges.prompt: Implement Cart: add (merging quantities and rejecting non-positive quantities with InvalidArgumentException), remove, subtotal, a 10% discount when the subtotal is at least 100.00, total and count. Work in integer cents to avoid float errors.
challenges.expected:
items: 7
subtotal: 102.50
discount: 10.25
total: 92.25
after remove: 12.50
error: qty must be positive
challenges.explain: Money is kept in integer cents so arithmetic is exact; array_sum/array_map compute totals and unset removes a line. Verified by running the solution with PHP.

challenges.title: A router with a middleware pipeline
challenges.prompt: Implement Router::dispatch so a request passes through the registered middleware (first registered runs outermost) before reaching the route handler, returning 404 for unknown paths. Auth short-circuits with 401 when the token is wrong, and Logger records the request and response status.
challenges.explain: array_reduce over the reversed middleware list builds nested closures (the onion model); a middleware can return early without calling $next. Verified by running the solution with PHP.
